# ABR Pro Towing

> ABR Pro Towing is a 24/7 towing and roadside assistance company based in Mississauga, Ontario, Canada. Phone: (647) 892-5167. Email: Abrprotowing@gmail.com. Open 24 hours, 7 days a week. Service area: Mississauga, Brampton, Oakville, Etobicoke, Milton, Toronto.

## Services
- [24/7 Emergency Towing](https://abrprotowing.com/services/emergency-towing.html): Breakdowns, cars that won't start, highway stops — we tow you to your home, mechanic, dealer or body shop.
- [Roadside Assistance](https://abrprotowing.com/services/roadside-assistance.html): Dead battery, flat tire or keys locked inside? Often we can fix it on the spot so you can drive away.
- [Accident Recovery](https://abrprotowing.com/services/accident-recovery.html): After a collision we clear and secure your vehicle and tow it to a collision centre, body shop or storage you choose.
- [Vehicle Transport & Long-Distance Towing](https://abrprotowing.com/services/vehicle-transport.html): Moving a car across the GTA or across Ontario? We transport non-running and running vehicles safely.
